nd736fb9e36.headline: Slight increase in the unemployment rate in Morocco
nd736fb9e36.summary: The High Commission for Planning announced a slight increase in Morocco's unemployment rate to 10.6% in Q3 2017.
nd736fb9e36.why: Unemployment rates are key indicators of economic health and labor market conditions, influencing consumer spending and policy decisions.
